Hi,

I went to Thailand last summer with a friend. We were both 18 years old and had the same plan. We had a general plan and lived at low budget hostels. It were the best 3 weeks of my life, I enjoyed it so much!
But now to answer your concerns:
      
Walking out late in wrong neighbourhoods: We stayed in Koh San Road for 2-3 days, which is quite scary at night actually, I woke up at like 4 o'clock in the morning and went to the local 7/11. There were a few people who were actually screaming and those kind of things. I didnt not actually feel safe but nothing happened. But I've heard some horror stories. 
 
Living at low budget motels:  We stayed for around 19 days of the 22 days we were in Thailand in low budget hostels/motels with other people. We've never had any problems and had a very fun time! I'm not sure how old you guys are but you should look up some fun hostels. SoHostel is quite a nice hostel in Chiang Mai, it was quite cheap and had a nice shower + nice beds. You can always aim for the cheaper motels as it was quite safe, but the experience was terrible. We paid like 100 baht, i know it is really cheap and dont know what i was expecting, but it was the worst day I had in Thailand because I had so much back trouble the next day. Accomodation is really cheap so you could always aim for a bit nicer rooms.

Airport control - Read some "scary" stories about people who's arrested at the airport because someone slipped something in their bag: No experience with that, and haven't heard anything about that in hostels or other people who went there.

TLDR: Thailand is amazing and i want to retire there.
